about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Robin L. Kelly

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GIVING VOICE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION PRINCIPLES
statements.title: GIVING VOICE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION PRINCIPLES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, since day one, this President and his administration have waged war on diversity, equity, and inclusion.
Let's be clear: DEI means all of us.
DEI means helping people of every background overcome barriers in their way.
Trump is trying to erase Black history, gut programs that benefit us, and target anything that says DEI.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ACTION FOR DENTAL HEALTH ACT
statements.title: ACTION FOR DENTAL HEALTH ACT
sentences: By supporting local organizations and strengthening existing resources, we will expand oral healthcare in underserved communities, reducing dental disease and preventing costly emergency room visits.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THANKING JESSICA LEE
statements.title: THANKING JESSICA LEE
sentences: Jessica came to my office from Giffords, bringing a steady commitment to public service and community safety that has shaped everything she touches.
She brought national attention to moms forced into dangerous births and families who continue to lose loved ones due to gun violence.
Somewhere along the way, in studio and during filming, she started calling me ``One Take Kelly,'' a title I will accept with pride.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GUN VIOLENCE AWARENESS MONTH
statements.title: GUN VIOLENCE AWARENESS MONTH
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today because, as we all know, there is a gun violence epidemic in our country.

I don't know if the Congresswoman realized this, but 10 years ago yesterday, Katherine Clark, the late, great John Lewis, John Larson, David Cicilline, and myself led the sit-in on the floor because we could not get any movement to deal with gun violence prevention.
Nothing happened right away, but we were making a statement that needed to be made, and, eventually, we did get a Bipartisan Safer Communities Act.
What should have been a celebration of freedom turned into a horrific reminder that we are not free from gun violence.
You can also reopen the White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention.
You can tell the ATF to overturn their 30 new rules that make it easier to traffic illegal guns and harder for law enforcement to investigate gun crimes.
I know that the President will not put forward any of these real solutions to gun violence because, frankly, he really doesn't care.
While gun violence became the leading cause of death for all children and teenagers in 2020, it has been the leading cause of death for Black children since 2006.
We have seen success because of our local efforts, our CBI programs, and our local police rebuilding trust with the community.
We know there is more to be done: ban on assault weapons, safe storage, resources that help those organizations on the ground, and I can go on and on and on.
People deserve the right to be able to play in a park, ride on a bus, come out of choir practice, get off the bus, and get tea from Starbucks.
We need a President and more Members of Congress to realize no one is truly safe until we are all safe, and we need to do more around gun violence prevention.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PASSING GUN SAFETY LAWS
statements.title: PASSING GUN SAFETY LAWS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today because there is a gun violence epidemic in America.
I have spoken loudly and clearly on gun safety again and again, shooting after shooting.
Americans need real action by Congress to end gun violence.
If the people in charge refuse to pass gun safety legislation, I will always make sure that Americans know there are Members of Congress who actually represent their needs and demands.
We need to pass lifesaving gun safety laws.

That means universal background checks, funding and support for community violence intervention organizations, safe storage laws to prevent unintentional shootings, an assault weapons ban, and standard marketing practices to hold the gun industry accountable.
We know those solutions to end gun violence, yet the Trump administration refuses to act.
On day one in the Oval Office, President Trump shut the doors of the White House Gun Violence Prevention Office.
CVI organizations are led by trusted community members who offer job training, mental health resources, de-escalation tactics, and more to keep our neighborhoods safe.
CVI strategies are proven, evidence-based solutions to gun violence, yet this administration decided they are inefficient.
After a gunman stormed the White House Correspondents' Dinner, President Trump didn't want gun safety reform.
He wanted to keep himself and his billionaire donors safe while over 120 Americans continue to die every day.
They are trying to jam through bills that would allow people to mail guns through the United States Postal Service, eliminate background checks, and allow domestic abusers to buy guns.
I was proud to play an essential role in passing the first Federal gun safety legislation in nearly 30 years, but Americans cannot wait another 30 years for Congress to act.
We have lost daughters and sons, nephews and nieces, brothers and sisters, and mothers and fathers to gun violence.
Hadiya's friends and family started the Wear Orange movement to raise awareness of gun violence.
Now, the color orange has become a beacon for action and advocacy against gun violence.
Today, I introduce the Wear Orange Resolution in honor of Hadiya and every victim of gun violence, just as I have since 2015.
While gun violence became the leading cause of death for all children and teenagers in 2020, it has been the leading cause of death for Black children since 2006.
Since then, I have never stopped fighting for victims and survivors of gun violence, and I never will.

I ran for office because I couldn't stand by and watch as Congress did nothing as children like Hadiya, those in Newtown--and I could go on and on and on--were killed, and also those that have been injured mentally and physically.
I will never give up this effort because this epidemic must end. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FOURTH ANNIVERSARY OF THE TOPS SUPERMARKET SHOOTING IN BUFFALO, NEW YORK
statements.title: FOURTH ANNIVERSARY OF THE TOPS SUPERMARKET SHOOTING IN BUFFALO, NEW YORK
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as a member of the Congressional Black Caucus and the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force, I rise today to remember the 10 lives stolen, the 3 people injured, and the survivors of the hateful mass shooting in Buffalo 4 years ago.
I remember their lives, but I also urge Congress to actually do something meaningful to honor them and all survivors of gun violence.
Congress passed the first Federal gun safety law in nearly 30 years, but the American people cannot wait another 30 years.
We need universal background checks, red flag laws, safe storage, assault weapons ban, community violence intervention funding, and better support for survivors.
It is not a young man riding on the CTA bus.

It is not even Members of Congress that have moved us, but I will not stop fighting until everyone, no matter where they live, the color of their skin, who they love, or even how they vote, we all need to live free from gun violence.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANOTHER BLIGHT ON AMERICAN HISTORY
statements.title: ANOTHER BLIGHT ON AMERICAN HISTORY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise because the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act, dealing a devastating blow to our democracy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IMPEACH SECRETARY NOEM
statements.title: IMPEACH SECRETARY NOEM
sentences: They dragged U.S. citizens and noncitizens alike out of their beds in the middle of the night.
I don't understand this President's obsession with Venezuela, but they did not arrest a single member from that gang.
Is Secretary Noem recruiting January 6 insurrectionists?
I was one of the last Members of Congress to escape the House gallery on January 6.
Insurrectionists are not fit to serve as law enforcement.
Mr. Speaker, before my colleague from Texas walks out, I will do whatever I can do to help him because the Chicagoland area is number three.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today to announce I will be impeaching Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MEDICAL BILLS ARE TOO HIGH
statements.title: MEDICAL BILLS ARE TOO HIGH
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today as the chair of the Congressional Black Caucus Health Braintrust to urge my colleagues across the aisle to extend the ACA tax credits.
The ACA premium tax credits provide affordable care to her employees, allowing her coffee shop and her employees to thrive.
They also provide jobs for more people, but they all receive affordable healthcare through the ACA.
Without the ACA tax credits, their employees may have no other option but to go uninsured or find another job.
Let's extend the ACA premium tax credits.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL GUARD DEPLOYMENT
statements.title: NATIONAL GUARD DEPLOYMENT
sentences: He wasted $1 million every day to house the National Guard in D.C., and now he wants to further misuse taxpayer dollars instead of investing in real, permanent solutions to gun violence.
Like D.C., I am sure Chicago can use money for more police, mental health counselors, social workers, and community violence intervention programs.
President Trump is actively making gun violence worse.
Gun violence is a public health issue, but the CDC has been stripped of medical experts and leaders.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to President Trump's rescission package that steals $400 million from PEPFAR, a lifesaving global health program.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL GUN VIOLENCE AWARENESS MONTH
statements.title: NATIONAL GUN VIOLENCE AWARENESS MONTH
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today because there is a gun violence epidemic in America.
I have spoken loudly and clearly on gun safety again and again and again, shooting after shooting.
Americans need real action by Congress to end gun violence.
That means universal background checks, funding and support for community violence intervention organizations, safe storage laws to prevent unintentional shootings, and an assault weapons ban.
We know the solution is to end gun violence, and yet the Trump administration and this legislative body refuses to act.
On day one in the Oval Office, President Trump shut the doors of the White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention.
CVI organizations are led by trusted community members who offer job training, mental health resources, de-escalation tactics, and more to keep our neighborhoods safe.
CVI strategies are proven, evidence-based solutions to gun violence, and yet the Trump administration decided they are inefficient.
Americans cannot afford the cost of gun violence, not in dollars, in pain, or in grief.
This past weekend, I joined survivors of gun violence in an environmentally-friendly balloon release to honor the 46,000 lives lost to gun violence every year.
They have lost daughters and sons, nephews and nieces, siblings, mothers and fathers to gun violence.
Hadiya's friends and family started the Wear Orange movement to raise awareness of gun violence.
Now the orange color has become a beacon for activity and advocacy against gun violence.
While gun violence became the leading cause of death for all children and teenagers in 2020, it has been the leading cause of death for Black children since 2006.
Since then, I have never, ever stopped fighting for her, and I will never stop until we end gun violence once and for all.
Since they started the Wear Orange movement in 2015, I have introduced the Wear Orange Resolution every year to honor Hadiya.
I ran for office because I couldn't stand by and watch as Congress did nothing as children like Hadiya were ripped away from families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HEALTH DISPARITIES IN MINORITY COMMUNITIES
statements.title: HEALTH DISPARITIES IN MINORITY COMMUNITIES
sentences: Let us not forget gun violence, a public health crisis and emergency in our country.
Black people die from gun violence at 2.7 times the rate of White people.
I have heard countless stories from parents who have turned their pain into purpose after losing a child to gun violence, determined not to let another family go through the same grief.
I continue to fight to end gun violence because of these families.
House Republicans want to slash Medicaid by $880 billion.
Their budget is an attack against millions of Americans who depend on Medicaid for healthcare.
I have heard from another mother whose entire family relies on Medicaid for lifesaving care.
As House Republicans attack Medicaid, Elon Musk and his unqualified team at DOGE have slashed 20,000 jobs at the Department of Health and Human Services.
These programs are meant to help women, veterans, Black people, members of the LGBTQ+ community, and, frankly, all of us.
These cuts to Medicaid and our country's healthcare infrastructure are simply cruel and will leave all Americans' health in limbo.
I have introduced legislation to help diversify clinical trials so medical breakthroughs can reach the patients who need treatment the most.
I am determined to continue to march forward arm in arm with my CBC colleagues and allies to fight for our healthcare.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAKING OUR VOICES HEARD
statements.title: MAKING OUR VOICES HEARD
sentences: Based on these last 8 weeks, we know who Trump prioritizes: his billionaire friends and big corporations.
Trump likes to talk a big game about border control and our country's fentanyl crisis.
He plays as the world's biggest bully and hits our closest allies with tariffs.
Last September, Kankakee County in my district received funding to help law enforcement crack down on illicit drug trafficking and address the overdose epidemic.
I, alongside House Democrats, have also been at the negotiation table, but we will never negotiate away veterans' benefits, healthcare, or people's Social Security.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMERICAN FAMILIES WILL PAY FOR REPUBLICAN TAX CUT
statements.title: AMERICAN FAMILIES WILL PAY FOR REPUBLICAN TAX CUT
sentences: The Republican budget cuts at least $880 billion from Medicaid.
Republicans represent millions and millions of Americans who rely on Medicaid and CHIP, and none of them, not a single one, voted with these constituents in mind. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNELECTED BILLIONAIRE RUNNING OUR COUNTRY
statements.title: UNELECTED BILLIONAIRE RUNNING OUR COUNTRY
sentences: He won the popular vote and the electoral college.
Just this week, he threatened tariffs against our closest neighbors, import taxes that would drive up the costs for American consumers.
Promises from Canada and Mexico that they were already planning to do around border security.
To make matters worse, while President Trump plays the bully on the world stage, an unelected billionaire has been running our government.
He has installed loyalists who stand to profit from unrestricted access to government records and the personal data of millions of Americans.
He uses his social media empire to amplify voices that agree with him and to spread misinformation designed to divide and destabilize.
Here at home, this administration has found a new scapegoat for everything that goes wrong: diversity, equity, and inclusion.
Must be diversity, equity, and inclusion.
Republicans blame DEI not because it is responsible but because it is an easy target because fear and division are their most effective tools.
Martin Luther King, Rosa Parks, John Lewis, Maya Angelou, A. Philip Randolph, and many more titans for diversity, equity, and inclusion played essential roles in shaping our Nation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: This includes transgender children who make up a very small number of young athletes.
A transgender child who joins a sports team does so for the same reason that any other child does.
This typical experience, however, has been stifled by politicians who want to exercise authority on transgender students by prohibiting them from participating on sports teams with their peers.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to oppose this bill.
